title: Tri-Particle Simulation
shortDescription: An interactive simulation of three distinct particle species with configurable symmetric force interactions.
fullDescription: Extend the dual-particle model to three species (A, B, C) with 6 symmetric force parameters. All cross-species forces are equal in both directions (A↔B = B↔A), producing rich emergent behaviors from tri-species dynamics. Explore presets like Tri-Phase Separation, Cyclic Chasing, and Proto-Organism to see how simple symmetric rules between three populations generate complex collective patterns.

title: Grover's Algorithm Demo
shortDescription: An interactive 25-bit quantum processor simulation demonstrating Grover's search algorithm and quantum amplitude amplification.
fullDescription: Explore the power of quantum search through an interactive 25-bit quantum processor simulation. Grover's Algorithm provides a quadratic speedup over classical search, finding a marked element in an unsorted database of N items in O(√N) steps. Watch as quantum superposition, phase kickback, and amplitude amplification work together to locate the target state with high probability. Adjust iterations to observe how the algorithm converges on the solution.

features: Interactive quantum circuit | Amplitude visualization | Iteration control | Probability tracking
